name: SQL & Querying
description: Focuses strictly on query writing: SELECT, JOINs, aggregations, window functions, and optimization.

subskills.name: Basic SELECT & Filtering
subskills.description: Extracting columns and filtering rows using WHERE, IN, BETWEEN, and LIKE operators.

subskills.name: Basic JOINs (INNER/LEFT)
subskills.description: Combining tables using INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN based on relational keys.

subskills.name: GROUP BY & Aggregations
subskills.description: Aggregating data using GROUP BY and functions like SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN, MAX.

subskills.name: Subqueries
subskills.description: Writing nested queries in SELECT, FROM, or WHERE clauses.

subskills.name: Window Functions
subskills.description: Performing calculations across a set of table rows related to the current row using OVER, PARTITION BY, RANK, etc.

subskills.name: Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
subskills.description: Creating temporary named result sets using the WITH clause for better readability and recursion.

subskills.name: Query Optimization
subskills.description: Analyzing execution plans and rewriting queries to reduce runtime and resource consumption.

subskills.name: Complex/Advanced JOINs
subskills.description: Using RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN, and self-joins for complex relational mapping.

github.signal: SQL files with complex window functions

cv.signal: Advanced SQL queries or optimization mentioned in projects

assessment.signal: Can write a query calculating running totals using window functions

junior.description: Can write basic operational queries to extract and aggregate data from a few joined tables.

mid.description: Can write analytical queries using CTEs and window functions for ranking and running totals.

senior.description: Can optimize slow-running queries, analyze execution plans, and handle complex self-joins or cross-joins.
